'''Nivora''' {{Lang|zh=娜波摩}} is a quest-exclusive [[NPC]] that first appears in [[The Star That Voyages Far]]. 

She is one of the many disguises of [[Schwarzloch]], the Grand Architect of the [[Fractsidus]].

==History==
Little is known about the real Nivora who existed before the Grand Architect took on her identity, but due to the Grand Architect only appearing through the borrowed identities of real people, legendary beings and others' memories of the dead,<ref>{{Quest|All That Sunlight Touches}}</ref> it is likely that the real Nivora is deceased.
